content: स्थण्डिलम् [स्थल्-इलच् नुक् लस्य डः <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A piece of ground (levelled, squared and prepared for a sacrifice), an altar; निषेदुषी स्थण्डिल एव केवले <ls>Ku. 5. 12</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 11. 45</ls>. .²2 A barren field. .²3 A heap of clods. .²4 A limit, boundary. .²5 A land-mark. .²6 A place, ground (as before a house); इह तु स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे <ls>Rām. 2. 111. 13</ls>.
